goal: You're playing both sides of the office. What you do on one side changes the other. Get both sides to press their final button, then walk out an exit.

hud.move: Drag here to walk. On a computer, WASD or the arrow keys work too.
hud.use: When something near you glows, tap USE (or press E) to use it.
hud.switch: Switch to your partner's side. Everything you did carries over, so go and see what your buttons changed. Online, your partner plays this side.

sideLine.mine: Glows in your colour: changes your side
sideLine.partner: Glows in your partner's colour: changes their side

flooded.title: Flooded room
flooded.text: You can't get in yet. A drain valve, usually on your partner's side, empties it for good.

dark.title: Dark room
dark.text: The lights are off, so you can only see close by. Find the light switch, or ask your partner.

text.true: Pressed. If nothing changed here, it changed on your partner's side.
text.*: Tap USE to press it. It changes something, often on your partner's side.

text.true: Switched on. Its label says what it controls.
text.*: Tap USE to flip it. Its label says what it controls.

text.true: Open, and it stays open. Check your partner's side for what it changed.
text.*: Tap USE to open it. Sprinklers put out fire and drain valves empty flooded rooms, usually on the other side.
Tap USE to turn the lights on or off. In the dark you can only see close by.
Tap USE to switch lasers on or off, usually on your partner's side. Leave them off until your partner is through.

text.true: Pressed! Now the other side needs to press theirs.
text.*: Press it. The exits open once both sides have pressed their final button.
There's no handle on this side. A button on your partner's side opens it.
Opened by the keypad next to it.
Tap USE to enter a code. It shows four colours: the digits are on your partner's coloured panels, in that order.
These digits are for your partner's keypad. Tell them each colour and its number.
Locked. Find the key on this side, then tap USE here.

text.home: Tap USE to pick it up. It opens the key door on this side.
Tap USE to pick it up. It breaks the cracked wall on this side.

text.*: Bring the bomb from this side and tap USE to blow it open.

text.false: Off for now. Get through before they switch back on.
text.*: Blocked. A laser lever, usually on your partner's side, switches them off.
Blocked. Sprinklers, usually on your partner's side, put it out for good.
Locked until both sides have pressed their final button.
Keep your distance. If they catch you, you move slowly and see less for a few seconds.
